Pool of Radiance

A cluebook for the 1988 SSI/TSR Gold Box classic: reclaim Phlan, complete the city's commissions, and destroy the Pool of Radiance.

Contents

  1. The game at a glance
  2. Phlan and the surrounding areas
  3. Mage and cleric spells
  4. Classes and races
  5. Walkthrough
  6. Strategy notes

The game at a glance

SettingPhlan, near the Moonsea in the Forgotten Realms
GoalReclaim the ruined city and destroy the Pool of Radiance
PartyUp to six adventurers, with optional hired NPCs
RulesAD&D 1st edition adapted for the Gold Box engine
DeveloperStrategic Simulations, Inc. (SSI), 1988
Trainer maps30 keyed areas, including districts, lairs, and wilderness locations

The story

Phlan was once a prosperous city on the Moonsea. Monsters now occupy its districts, while the surviving citizens hold a small civilized section. The City Council hires your party to reclaim the ruins, investigate the force behind the invasion, and restore Phlan one commission at a time.

The hidden enemy is Tyranthraxus, a possessing spirit using an ancient bronze dragon as its vessel. Follow the Council's leads through the monster-held districts, gather the equipment and knowledge needed for the endgame, then reach the Pool of Radiance and destroy the artifact that sustains the evil.

Phlan and the surrounding areas

The Maps tab in the trainer contains the same area reference and decoded indoor geometry. Coordinates use (x, y), with x increasing east and y increasing south.

New Phlan (16×15)

The civilized hub — City Council Clerk issues commissions and pays rewards; four Training Halls (1,000 gp per level); Temples of Tyr, Sune and Tempus (heal/raise/cure); weapon, armor, magic-item and scroll shops (daytime only); the Inn; and the Docks (boat to Sokal Keep). Return here between commissions to train, heal and resupply. The harbour east of the sea wall is water — the squares shaded blue are off the map.

Kuto's Well (16×16)

Free the Wide-Eyed Woman (banded mail +1, quarter staff +1, bracers AC 4), then descend the well to fight Norris the Gray in the catacombs.

PositionLocationNotes
(7, 7)Well down to catacombs (E4)Descend to Norris the Gray (drops Long Sword +1 + a Boss note).

Kuto's Well — Catacombs (16×16)

Down the well. Norris the Gray (half-orc Fighter 5) holds the bandit hideout with 5 lizardmen and 9 kobold leaders; he drops a Long Sword +1 and a note from the Boss, and his hoard sits north-east of the catacombs. You cannot rest down here until Norris is dead. The rooms are cut out of rock — the wide stone blocks below are solid, not unexplored.

Podol Plaza (16×16)

Auction spy commission — on entry choose 'disguise yourself as monsters'. Garwin escapes no matter your bid; witnessing it completes the commission.

Mendor's Library (16×16)

Cast Knock to enter. Search Philosophy (2) and History (4) for Tyranthraxus's origin; the Rhetoric section (5) hides a Basilisk — equip mirrors! Leaving with a book triggers a spectre.

Thieves' guild — traps everywhere. Move in Search Mode, cast Find Traps, bring a thief + Knock. Reveals Cadorna's treachery and that the Boss is a dragon in Valjevo Castle.

Cadorna Textile House (16×16)

Councilman Cadorna's commission — recover the iron treasure box (holds the Gauntlets of Ogre Power, STR 18/00). Opening it breaks the seal and earns his enmity; a thief can re-forge it. No keyed locations transcribed — the walls below are the game's own.

Wealthy District (16×16)

Grinding ground (orcs/hobgoblins/ogres). Mace, the half-orc cleric who runs the Temple of Bane next door, lives in a mansion here. Clearing this block and the temple are one commission. No keyed locations transcribed — the walls below are the game's own.

Temple of Bane (16×16)

The great temple of Ilmater, converted to the worship of Bane. Enter with the leather holy symbols from Podol Plaza. Bishop Braccio lends you Dirtan, a 6th-level gnome cleric, if you agree to recover Ilmater's lost artifacts. Mace intends to let you find the hidden treasure and then kill you for it — the payoff is Dust of Disappearance (save it for the final fight) and a Ring of Feather Falling. The colonnade down the middle of the nave is the temple proper.

PositionLocationNotes
(2, 7)Mace's cultists (8)The half-orc cleric's motley group of cultists and slaves.
(5, 5)Temple treasure (9)Ilmater's hidden artifacts; also marked at (13,9) and (9,12).
(15, 7)Altar chamber (10)East end of the nave.

Valhingen Graveyard (16×16)

A cauldron of undead, and the hardest of the city commissions — take it late. Everything here drains levels; bring Restoration scrolls, and remember Tyr's temple can restore them. The vampire must be killed TWICE (once in the crypt, then again over his coffin) before the graveyard clears. Clear the spectres at 13 and 16 before the vampire's room will open.

Nomad Camp (16×16)

Overland (12, 11) — always visible. Parley rather than attack: stay for the feast, hear the chief out, then fight the kobold army with the nomads for 5,000 gp, a Two-Handed Sword +2 and a Wand of Magic Missiles. The kobolds come in 3 waves; at the third, go with the chief to finish them for the bigger reward. Do not backstab the nomads mid-fight — both sides turn on you. The shaded ring is the tripwire line and the east edge is the stream.

PositionLocationNotes
(3, 8)Tripwire ring (1)Crossing it sets off alarms and the nomads turn out in force. Also at (10,1) and (9,14).
(9, 12)Your hut (2)Where they put you up; rest here until the kobolds come.
(0, 9)The forest (3)Outside the tripwire — caught out here you fight the kobolds alone.

Kobold Caves (16×16)

Overland (6, 15) east — kobold patrols thicken as you approach. Two entrances at the south edge: the small cave is the kobold cavern, the large cave is a wyvern lair that connects to it. Low ceilings cut movement, AC and damage in every fight down here, and the kobolds have trapped the place — move in Search Mode and let a thief disarm what you find.

Yarash's Pyramid — Level 1 west (16×16)

Rowboat from the overland shore at (6, 16). The mad sorcerer Yarash is poisoning the Stojanow River, turning lizardmen into freshwater sahuagin. Three sets of teleporters (A, B and C) run the pyramid; throwing a rock through a portal toggles where it goes. You can rest on either half of level 1 once that half's random encounters are done. The sealed cells the schematic shows are teleport destinations — you arrive in them, you cannot walk in.

Yarash's Pyramid — Level 1 east (16×16)

The east half of the pyramid's base, reached through the secret entrance between the halves or by teleporter. Same rules as the west half.

Yarash's Pyramid — Level 2 (16×16)

The middle level; safe to rest anywhere. Free the enslaved lizardmen — be Nice — for the friend-word SAVIOR, which buys you the alliance at Lizard Man Keep without a bloodbath.

Yarash's Pyramid — Level 3 (16×16)

The top level, where Yarash himself is. Password NOKNOK. The colour dial at (5, 0) aims the treasure teleporter: Blue = the way out, Copper / Silver / Gold = three treasure rooms with 3 random magic items each. Kill Yarash and the river starts to clear.

Lizard Man Keep (16×16)

Overland (11, 8) — obvious among the trees. An old wizard's field blocks spellcasting over the whole keep, so this is a melee fight. The old chief is being usurped by a young warrior: give the old lizardman SAVIOR (from Yarash's level 2) and champion him in single combat against Drythh to win the alliance without fighting the tribe. Rubbled walls and swamp squares are drawn as ordinary floor below — only the game's walls are shown.

Lizard Man Catacombs (16×16)

Under the keep, through any of the six holes or the stairs at (9, 8). Lizard men ambush from the pools until they are all dead; once they are, swim the pools for the treasure the castle's original owners left — 3× Shield +2 among it. The first time you come down, every remaining giant lizard attacks at once.

Buccaneer's Base (16×16)

Overland (12, 31) — only appears once you take the commission to rescue the Bivant heir. The fast way out: scout first, then open the animal pen to start a stampede, free the boy while the guards chase animals, and run for the front gate. The longer you stay in the compound the more buccaneer groups you fight on the way out.

Outpost of Zhentil Keep (16×16)

Overland (3, 32) — only enterable once you carry Cadorna's diplomatic pouch. The pouch asks the Keepers to return you to Phlan with your heads on a pike; they try that night. Set a watch, survive the ambush, and kill the Commandant for a Javelin of Lightning (one of the few things that hurts the final dragon), Plate Mail +2 and a Ring of Fire Resistance.

Stojanow Gate (16×16)

The fortified gate on the road to Valjevo Castle. Buy the merchant's wagon (250 gp, daylight only) as a disguise: the bugbear patrol takes 15 gp and waves you through, letting you hit each guard tower separately by surprise. Undisguised you bash both gates under volleys of boulders and fight everything at once. Knock opens the gates; up to 3× Ring of Protection +2 is the reward. (The DOS game has no fire trap or flooded passage — those are NES additions.)

PositionLocationNotes
(4, 14)Merchant in wagon (1)Daylight only; 250 gp for the wagon. Also at (11,14).
(8, 11)Bugbear patrol (2)Disguised and unseen through, you pass free.
(8, 9)Southern gate (3)Barred by massive beams — Knock or massive Strength.
(8, 7)Northern gate (4)The same again; guards throw boulders if you bash it.
(8, 6)Ettin ambush (5)Both towers' ettins meet you here if you opened both gates by force.
(4, 8)West tower (6)Level-6 mage + aides + 3 ettins. Surprise them if you sneaked past.
(11, 8)East tower (7)The same garrison again — if the alarm sounds you meet both.

Valjevo Castle — SW (entry) (16×16)

The endgame, entered here. Four quadrants (SW/NW/NE/SE) ring a poisonous hedge maze around the Inner Tower and the Pool. Passwords HARASH / TYRANTHRAXUS / RHODIA. Do NOT steal from the Altar of Bane.

Valjevo Castle — NW (16×16)

North-west quadrant; leads east to the NE quadrant and south back to the SW entry.

Valjevo Castle — NE (16×16)

North-east quadrant; leads west to the NW quadrant and south to the SE quadrant.

Valjevo Castle — SE (16×16)

South-east quadrant; leads west to the SW entry and north to the NE quadrant.

PositionLocationNotes
(15, 10)Flame Tongue Long Sword +2 (well)Down the well in this quadrant.

Valjevo Castle — Inner Tower, lower level (16×16)

Reached through the hedge maze: the stairs are behind an illusory wall in the NW quadrant, or in through the SE entrance. Medusa's chamber is down here — equip mirrors; she has only ~30 HP, so hit her hard on the first round. The false 'Tyranthraxus' holds court in the throne room; parley and you can walk away with Long Sword +5, Ring of Protection +3 and Gauntlets of Ogre Power without a fight.

Valjevo Castle — Inner Tower, upper level (16×16)

The top of the tower, and the end of the game. Safe to rest anywhere up here until you meet Tyranthraxus. Genheeris, a level-7 mage, offers to join — take him for the Wand of Lightning Bolt. Then two back-to-back fights with no rest between: ~12 eighth-level fighters, then Tyranthraxus in the bronze dragon. Spread out against the lightning breath, use Dust of Disappearance, and answer 'attack' when he offers to let each character join him.

PositionLocationNotes
(5, 4)Stairs to lower level (1)The tower occupies columns 1–8, rows 4–11 of this block.
(7, 5)Trap-door room (2)The trap door drops to Medusa's chamber — glancing down can petrify.
(1, 7)Waiting room (3)Messengers for Genheeris and Tyranthraxus. Parley → Nice sends one to Genheeris.
(2, 4)Genheeris' office (4)Promise to attack Tyranthraxus at once and he joins.
(2, 9)Tyranthraxus' lair (5)Buff everything before you step in. The Pool of Radiance is at (2, 10).

Wilderness — Moonsea overland (42×33)

Opened by clearing Sokal Keep; the boat runs here from the Phlan docks. Travel is square by square with a 5% chance of an encounter per step, and the danger set depends only on your X column (Western 2–15, Central 16–28, Eastern 29–41). Outdoor fights are large and have no choke points — avoid them unless you want the challenge. Terrain below is transcribed from the clue-book map, not decoded from the game, so treat it as a travel aid; your live position and the teleport target are read from and written to the game itself and are exact.

Mage and cleric spells

Pool of Radiance uses separate memorized-spell slots for clerics and magic-users. The list below follows the trainer's verified record order.

Cleric spells

LevelSpellEffect
1BlessAllies not yet adjacent to a foe get +1 to hit and +5 morale. Cast before contact.
1CurseEnemies get -1 to hit and -5 morale (no save) — helps force surrenders.
1Cure Light WoundsRestores 1d8 HP. The ONLY castable healing spell in the game — keep several ready.
1Cause Light WoundsTouch attack for 1d8 damage.
1Detect MagicFlags magic items.
1Protection from Evil-2 AC and saves vs evil creatures.
1Protection from Good-2 AC and saves vs good creatures.
1Resist ColdCold resistance (little used — nothing deals cold).
2Find TrapsReveals traps ahead.
2Hold PersonParalyzes up to 3 humanoids; a held target is auto-killed by any hit. Single-target = -2 to its save.
2Resist FireHalves fire damage — mitigates the final dragon's fiery aura.
2Silence 15' RadiusShuts down enemy spellcasters in the area.
2Slow PoisonTemporarily staves off a poisoned character's death.
2Snake CharmNeutralizes snakes.
2Spiritual HammerConjures a striking hammer at range.
3Animate DeadRaises slain foes as temporary skeleton/zombie allies.
3Cure BlindnessCures blindness.
3Cause BlindnessBlinds a foe.
3Cure DiseaseCures disease (e.g. from mummies).
3Cause DiseaseInflicts disease.
3Dispel MagicCounters hostile charm/hold; base 50% ± level difference.
3PrayerParty-wide +1 to hit & saves for allies, -1 for enemies (no save).
3Remove CurseRemoves a curse / lets a cursed item be unequipped.
3Bestow CurseCurses a foe.

Mage spells

LevelSpellEffect
1Burning HandsShort-range fire cone.
1Charm PersonCharms a humanoid to your side (no XP for a blue-named kill).
1Detect MagicFlags magic items.
1EnlargeRaises a target's Strength, up to 18/00 at caster level 6 — a top fighter buff.
1ReduceShrinks a target.
1FriendsBrief Charisma boost (too short to matter).
1Magic Missile1d4+1 per missile, unerring, no save. +1 missile at each odd level.
1Protection from Evil-2 AC & saves vs evil.
1Protection from Good-2 AC & saves vs good — works on the Lawful-Good possessed dragon!
1Read MagicIdentifies a scroll so it can be scribed.
1ShieldImmunity to Magic Missile + good AC vs missiles; +1 saves.
1Shocking GraspElectric touch attack.
1SleepTHE early-game king. Sleeps 4d4 HD of <6-HD creatures, NO save; sleeping foes die to one hit.
2Detect InvisibilityReveals invisible creatures.
2InvisibilityTarget is invisible until it attacks/casts. Great pre-combat setup.
2KnockOpens locked/stuck doors — needed for Mendor's Library.
2Mirror Image1d4 decoys absorb single-target hits — excellent vs level-drainers.
2Ray of EnfeeblementWeakens a foe (unreliable at low level).
2Stinking Cloud2x2 cloud; failed poison save = helpless 1d4+1 rounds. AI won't enter it — walls off doorways.
2StrengthRaises a target's Strength.
3BlinkCaster can only be hit by area effects after acting.
3Dispel MagicCounters hostile magic.
3Fireball(level)d6 fire, save for half. Diameter 5 outdoors / 7 indoors. No damage cap — clears hordes.
3HasteDoubles allies' movement AND attacks (ages each 1 year). Cast just before the boss.
3Hold PersonMage version: holds up to 4 humanoids.
3Invisibility 10' RadiusParty-wide invisibility.
3Lightning Bolt(level)d6 electrical line that bounces off walls (can hit twice — or your own party).

Walkthrough

  1. Establish the party. Create a balanced six-person party. Include a front-line fighter, a cleric for healing and turning undead, a thief for traps, and at least one magic-user for Sleep and area spells.
  2. Reclaim the first districts. Begin with the Slums, then Sokal Keep and Kuto's Well. Report completed commissions to the Council, train at the appropriate hall, and return to Phlan to heal, identify treasure, and restock.
  3. Investigate the conspirators. Work through Podol Plaza, Mendor's Library, Kovel Mansion, and the Cadorna Textile House. Use Knock and Find Traps, search thoroughly, and preserve clues that identify the Boss and the route to the castle.
  4. Break the enemy's strongholds. Clear the Wealthy District and Temple of Bane. Collect the holy symbols needed to enter Bane's temple and keep valuable artifacts, scrolls, and Dust of Disappearance for later missions.
  5. Complete the wilderness commissions. Travel beyond Sokal Keep for the nomad, Valjevo, Zhentil, and other wilderness encounters. These missions provide powerful equipment and the levels needed for the undead districts and final castle.
  6. Clear Valhingen Graveyard. Save this commission for a strong party. Kill the spectre groups that block the vampire, destroy the vampire's coffin, then defeat the vampire again. Carry Restoration scrolls and use magic weapons against level-draining undead.
  7. Reach Valjevo Castle. Use the washerwomen's disguises and the passwords RHODIA, TYRANTHRAXUS, and HARASH to pass the approach. Survive the poison hedge maze and do not spend the party's best consumables before the final sequence.
  8. Destroy the Pool. Fight the castle defenders, then face Tyranthraxus in the bronze dragon. He is immune to normal spell attacks, so protect the party, use Dust of Disappearance to deny his lightning breath, and win with enchanted weapons. Refuse his offer to join, then destroy the Pool of Radiance.

Strategy notes

  • Training matters. Experience does not automatically grant a level. Return to the correct Training Hall with 1,000 gp per level and train one level at a time.
  • Treasure is experience. Gold from treasure is a major source of experience. Monsters that flee or are charmed do not award normal experience, so do not let every encounter escape.
  • Use the right spell. Sleep is decisive early, Hold Person disables humanoids, Stinking Cloud controls doorways, and Fireball clears large groups. Memorize Cure Light Wounds and save scrolls for emergencies.
  • Manage equipment. Identify magic items, convert excess coin into portable forms, and keep silver or enchanted weapons available for creatures that resist ordinary steel.
  • Treat undead seriously. Level drain is permanent until restored. Bring Restoration scrolls, use cleric protections, and do not rest in Valhingen Graveyard while it remains uncleared.
  • Keep a backup. Save before commissions, boss encounters, and risky treasure searches. The trainer's live edits are separate from the game's own save process, so save from the game after confirming changes.
